dataset_type: Curated Workplace Incident SIF Precursor Benchmark
labeling_methodology: Campbell Institute / DEKRA SIF Criteria: A report is labeled as a SIF precursor (1) if high-energy hazard exposure occurred in the absence or failure of a primary direct control barrier, with realistic potential for fatality or permanent life-altering injury. Non-precursor reports (0) describe low-energy minor events with zero fatality potential.
disclaimer: Academic & research demonstration project. Statistical predictions from DistilBERT indicate text semantic classification likelihoods, NOT certified industrial safety guarantees. Human Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) officer review is mandatory for all workplace decisions.
